edge_thesis: Targeting short-horizon dislocations created by systematic flows: (1) post-open index/FX positioning and dealer hedging that can extend trends for a session, (2) crypto reflexive momentum after liquidity sweeps, and (3) a low-conviction ballast in a broad mutual fund sleeve to reduce portfolio-level drawdown variance. The counterparties are mostly urgency-driven traders (rebalance/hedge/stop-out flow) who cross spreads immediately rather than optimize entry.
